[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]] used a '''[[Nune-class Imperial shuttle|''Nune''-class Imperial shuttle]]''' for his personal transport.

==History==
In [[137 ABY]], Azard [[Massacre of New Coral City|dueled]] [[Imperial Knight]] [[Master]] [[Treis Sinde]] while [[Sigel Dare]], [[Monia Gahan]], [[Ronto (Klatooinian)|Ronto]] and other [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members escaped Mon Calamari aboard Azard's shuttle.
